subject: Follow-up: unit economics & multi-year discount framework — BrightFrame pilot
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@brightframe.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up from today’s call — pricing and commitment options

Evelyn, thanks again for the demo and for walking us through Redwood’s routing and caching levers — that was helpful. A few things I want to make sure we captured from our side from the discovery: 

- BrightFrame is planning an initial pilot (Q1) for a summarization/search feature: expected traffic ~30M tokens/month at start, ramping to ~120M tokens/month over 6–9 months if quality holds.
- We're an early-stage startup (Series A, ~35 engineers), running a freemium product and planning paid tier conversion in Q2. Budget for inference in year 1 is limited — we were thinking in the range of $30k–$60k for the next 12 months, but that’s flexible with the right committed discount.
- Our target unit economics to make the model work in the long run is roughly $300–$450 per 1M tokens; however, we could stretch toward $200/1M with a multi-year committed deal.

Could you confirm: how Redwood typically structures startup program credits vs. committed-use discounts? Also if you can share an initial price band (e.g., $/1M tokens) for a 12-month commit vs. a 24-month multi-year incentive, that’d help us prepare a PO/approval.

We'd also like to try a short committed-run (3 months) on a smaller pool to validate latency and cost before a full-scale commit — is that something you support?

Thanks — cc’ing our ops lead if needed.

Sam
Sam Park
Head of Platform
BrightFrame
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@brightframe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today’s call — pricing and commitment options

Sam — great to meet you yesterday, appreciate the clarity on volumes and the pilot goal. Recap + next steps below.

Recap of BrightFrame asks:
- Pilot start target: Q1, ~30M tokens/mo initial, ramp to ~120M tokens/mo in 6–9 months.
- Budget window: $30k–$60k Y1, flexible for committed reductions.
- Target unit econ: aiming for $300–$450 per 1M tokens; stretch to ~$200/1M with multi-year commitment.
- Interest in a short committed validation run (3 months) before a larger annual/multi-year commit.

What we can offer (initial guidance):
- Startup program credits: eligibility typically covers a one-time credit (value varies by program) and can offset early pilot months; we need the completed qualification form to confirm (attached: startup-qualification-form.pdf).
- 12-month committed-use: typical list-band for that workload profile would sit in the ~$350–$500 per 1M tokens range depending on sustained volume bands, batching profile, and acceptable latency SLOs.
- 24-month / multi-year incentive: with a 24-month firm commit and minimum annualized volume thresholds, we can get toward $200–$300 per 1M tokens. Exact milestones and ramp schedules matter — we’ll model a ramp-based discount to reflect progression from pilot to steady state.
- Short committed validation (3 months): yes, we can support an interim committed pool with a pro-rated discount; we usually treat that as a canary committed tranche that can roll into the larger commit.

Requested from BrightFrame: 
1) Please confirm the expected month-by-month token ramp (even a simple 4-line projection helps).
2) Complete the attached qualification form so we can evaluate startup credit eligibility.
3) Confirm whether finance needs a formal term sheet or PO to move forward — if yes, we’ll circulate a term-sheet-draft and route through our pricing approval.

Action items on our side: Ben (CC) will draft an initial term sheet with 12/24 month scenarios and an explicit $/1M table; Priyom will run the unit-econ model against your projected ramp once we have the month-by-month. I’ll also check startup credit program fit once the qualification form is back.

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx (blank model we will populate), startup-qualification-form.pdf

Proposed next step: Ben & I to send a draft term sheet by EOD tomorrow (Wed). If that timeline is tight on your side, let us know.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@brightframe.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today’s call — pricing and commitment options

Sam — looping in a quick note. We’ll put two scenarios in the term sheet:

A) 12-month firm commit with monthly true-ups — targeted blended price band $340–$420 per 1M tokens for the 30M -> 120M ramp. Final price will depend on effective monthly avg token consumption and whether you opt into KV cache/long-lived prefix caching.

B) 24-month multi-year incentive: with a 24-month firm commit and an annualized minimum (we’ll propose thresholds), landed price can move to the $200–$280 per 1M tokens band. We’ll include escape clauses for material traffic variance and a quarterly review cadence.

Canary / validation: we typically do a 3-month committed canary at a modestly higher band than the full commit; that can convert into the broader commit once adoption metrics are met.

I attached a draft term-sheet (term-sheet-draft.pdf) with placeholders for the ramp and minimums. Evelyn/ Priyom — I’ll update the pricing-model.xlsx with a few scenarios and send both to Sam by EOD.

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Park <sam.park@brightframe.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today’s call — pricing and commitment options

Thanks Evelyn and Ben — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Month-by-month pilot projection (confirmed): Month 1: 30M, Month 2: 45M, Month 3: 60M, Month 4: 85M, Month 5: 100M, Month 6+: 120M (steady).
- Budget framing: we can stretch to the high end of our window for Y1 (~$60k) if we land a 12-month commit at or under $350/1M for the first 6 months ramp and move to $250/1M for steady state months; alternatively, a 24-month structure at ~$220/1M avg would be attractive if we get favorable annualized minimums and rollback protection.
- We want the 3-month canary to run with a small dedicated pool and SLA targets (p95 latency <= 500ms) — please confirm feasibility.

Next steps from BrightFrame: we’ll complete the startup form and return by EOD tomorrow. We’d also like to get your populated pricing-model.xlsx to circulate internally with our CFO.

Looking forward to the term sheet. If you can include an appendix that shows the conversion from list $/1M to effective bill (after credits and batch savings) that would be very helpful for our finance team.

Sam
